attack.note: self-built white-box PGD on the E191 branch-A v3 identity model; SNR radius = per-trial L2 norm / 10^(SNR/20)

answers.a: A fixed-weight gate exists (3 of 349 points: E183+E65+subwin6, strict 0.9278-0.9640, Test S1 0.7052-0.7471, S2 0.7017-0.7221), but no deployable gate exists: weights cannot be selected with Test, and a Train-only (max loso_strict) rule degenerates to E183 alone (strict 0.9848, Test min 0.2733).
answers.b: Pareto frontier runs from E183 (0.9848 / 0.2733) through E183+E65+WCCN and E183+E65+subwin6 to subwin6 (0.3982 / 0.6916); the best countable compromise is E183 0.4 + E65 0.3 + subwin6 0.3 (strict 0.9640, Test 0.7052/0.7087).
answers.c: 8/11; #6 (U@95 0.8831), #7 and #8 fail (SNR30 RA 0.9473, ASafeR 0.9617; SNR20 much worse).
